about: Fouled-out players stay in; the penalty is a technical on the team. Real case: Lakers at Cavaliers Feb 5 2014 (Sacre). Ends on the result.
name: What happens if a team runs out of players
pinned: The rule keeps a fouled-out player on the court so the team never drops below five, and each extra foul costs another technical. Smart rule or unfair to the other team?
